basics.name: John Filhmar Ola
basics.label: Lead IT · Full-Stack Engineer · DevSecOps & Infrastructure
basics.headline: I build systems end to end — from first commit to production operation.
basics.summary: Lead IT at YouCode Technologies, responsible for multiple production systems end to end — architecture, full-stack development, automated testing, CI/CD, and on-premise infrastructure operations. Sole developer of a distributed real-time messaging platform spanning mobile client, backend microservices, deployment pipeline and production server management. Comfortable owning a system from first commit through to live operation, incident diagnosis and iteration. Promoted to a lead role within the first year.
basics.summaryShort: Lead IT and full-stack engineer. I architect, build, secure and operate production systems — mobile, backend, infrastructure.

work.name: YouCode Technologies
work.summary: Own multiple production systems end to end — architecture, development, CI/CD, security automation, and on-premise infrastructure operations across the company product suite.
highlights: Sole developer of Usapp, a secure real-time messaging platform — architected and built from scratch across the mobile application, distributed backend microservices, deployment pipeline and production server management.

Delivered production systems now in active commercial marketing: an LGU citizen-services application, a flexible-hierarchy HRIS serving government and private-sector clients, and a learning management system.
Own CI/CD across the product suite — automated build, test, security scanning, artifact signing and deployment pipelines, including self-hosted runner infrastructure.
Lead on-premise infrastructure operations: server provisioning, container orchestration, monitoring stack deployment, and production incident diagnosis.
Built hardware-to-server integration for a campus management system, enabling automated daily attendance capture and school security monitoring.
Designed cross-product notification architecture — all company systems dispatch push notifications through the messaging platform, consolidating delivery infrastructure and reducing SMS dependency.
Established performance and capacity baselines through load testing and infrastructure benchmarking, producing formal technical findings used in vendor and stakeholder decisions.

projects.name: Usapp
projects.description: A secure, real-time messaging platform built as a distributed system. Architected and developed single-handedly across the mobile client, backend microservices, deployment pipeline and production server operations. Serves as the notification backbone for the company's entire product suite, positioning it as a super-app foundation.
highlights: Distributed microservice backend with real-time messaging
Mobile application with push notification delivery
Full CI/CD pipeline with automated security scanning and signed artifacts
Production infrastructure and monitoring owned end to end
projects.note: Implementation details withheld under proprietary agreement.

projects.name: JMS E-Talyer
projects.description: Multi-branch automotive service management system with real-time monitoring and daily transaction reporting. Live in production on a rented VPS that I provision, secure, manage and operate myself, with features actively under ongoing development.
highlights: Live in production with ongoing feature development
Self-provisioned and self-managed VPS hosting — server provisioning, deployment, monitoring and maintenance owned end to end
Multi-branch operations with real-time monitoring and daily transaction reports
Four-workflow CI/CD pipeline: continuous integration, security scanning, gated deployment, and automated dependency management
Layered security scanning — static analysis, dependency auditing, secret scanning across full git history, dynamic testing, and container vulnerability scanning
Hardened container runtime: multi-stage builds, production-only dependencies, non-root user, correct signal handling, health checks
Application hardening: security headers, origin allow-listing, tiered rate limiting, CSRF protection scoped to the single cookie-authenticated route, and production error sanitisation
Manual-gated deployments with branch and environment guards; secrets injected at runtime with no credentials written to disk

projects.name: PeraPlano
projects.description: A free-to-use budgeting application for Android, built around privacy and minimal friction. User financial data is encrypted while remaining accessible to its owner, and budget movement is derived from transaction push notifications so users don't have to log every entry manually.
highlights: Encrypted user financial data — privacy-by-design for sensitive personal records
Derives income and expense tracking from transaction push notifications, minimising manual input
Daily, monthly and annual budgeting and savings goals with threshold alerts
Roadmap includes optional premium features via in-app purchases

projects.name: Kalusugapp
projects.description: Digitised health records and appointment management for rural clinics, improving record accessibility and scheduling efficiency for underserved communities.
highlights: Digital patient records replacing paper-based systems
Appointment scheduling and management
Built for low-resource clinic environments

projects.name: Flood Notification System
projects.displayName: Flood Notification System — IoT Early Warning
projects.description: Sensor-based early-warning system that alerts nearby residents to rising flood water through audible sirens, warning lights and automated SMS dispatch. Monitors water level and rate of rise per area, so residents can judge how fast conditions are worsening rather than only that a threshold was crossed.
highlights: Multi-channel alerting: audible sirens, warning lights, and GSM SMS dispatch
Tracks both water level and rate of rise per monitored area
Designed for community-level deployment in flood-prone areas
